Done. The script at `out/T2/solution.py` ran once and succeeded on the first execution.

What it does:
- Builds one keep-index set per 768-wide head segment (heads 0..4 and 6..11), applies it to the q, k and v segments of `c_attn.weight` columns and `c_attn.bias`, and to the rows of `c_proj.weight`, for all 12 layers.
- Asserts input shapes per layer, then the four required checks plus per-layer output shapes, before saving.
- Writes `out/T2/model.safetensors`, reloads it, and confirms 160 tensors.

The self-report is in `out/T2/REPORT.md`. Ready for `grade.py T2 --target gpt-2`.
